budget_basis: fixed episodes/updates and common hard caps; actual token/step counts reported, not forced equal
stop: Finish 4 predetermined batches; stop run on replay/nonfinite/identity/network errors and retain artifacts. No extra updates selected by validation results.
estimate_basis: engineering meta-to-summary timestamps only; planning allowance, not measured large-run throughput
validation: Run fixed 160-task FP32 validation only for B1 and each final fourth-update policy; no outcome-adaptive extra training.
proposal_rationale: Rule shaping is currently executable and cycle-neutral at gamma=1. Learned progress model failed independent baseline/credit checks. This route changes the original study and requires Zqqq/Qiu acceptance.

decision.recorded_by: Tutor for Zqqq-qq under explicit delegated review/route decision request
decision.scope: Limited-budget terminal vs rule option-potential study; not learned progress/neural SPA reproduction

checkpoint_selection: precommitted final fourth update; no best-val checkpoint selection

evaluation.baseline: original locked B1 evaluated under same settings; old 4-bit 160-task result not substituted

sampling.dropout: disabled with model.eval while gradients enabled during update
